verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for a cloud platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows a Terraform provider and a Resource Manager import job for state files. Neither documents versioning, review, or rollback of automations. Any version control would come from user-side Terraform or Git workflows, which earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
